title: Angelus Silesius: a Selection from the Rhymes of a German Mystic (Cherubic Wanderer)
author: Johann Scheffler / Angelus Silesius
description: Paul Carus presents an English selection from the rhymed mystical epigrams of Angelus Silesius, with an introduction and historical context.
editionNote: 1909 edition. Chicago: Open Court Publishing. Edition credit: Paul Carus (1852–1919).
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
